out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Multiple live cockroaches were found on and around the dish washing machine.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. EHS DISCUSSED PEST CONTROL WITH PIC. ACCORDING TO PIC, FACILITY RECEIVES PEST CONTROL EVERY TWO WEEKS. PIC PROVIDED MOST RECENT INVOICE FOR EHS TO REVIEW. EHS RECOMMENDS GETTING PEST CONTROL ONCE A WEEK UNTIL COCK ROACH ISSUE IS RESOLVED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: Raw beef stored immediately next to raw chicken in walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). NOTE: Discussed with PIC

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: lettuce, broad noodles, tofu, rice noodles, bean sprouts in 1: 48,46,46,46,48 degrees F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Food determined to be out of temperature less than 2 hours. Door of attached walk-in freezer was partially opened, and achieved an ambient temperature of 40 degrees F by the end of the inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. NOTE: PIC scheduled service of the cooler during the inspection for this evening. PIC agreed to limit access to the walk-in cooler, nd maintain a satisfactory ambient temperature by maintaining the walk-in freezer door as open as necessary.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating in an area where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. NOTE: Discussed with employee and PIC

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located to the left of the 3 vat sink is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. The hand washing sink had dirty dishes in the basin.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT HAND WASHING SINKS MUST BE ACCESSIBLE AT ALL TIMES FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS AND PREVENT THE POTENTIAL SPREAD OF FOOD BORNE ILLNESSES. PIC REMOVED DIRTY DISHES FROM THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the hand washing sink to the left of the 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT HAND WASHING SINKS IN FACILITY MUST REMAIN FULLY STOCKED AT ALL TIMES FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS. PIC RESTOCKED THE PAPER TOWELS AT THE HAND SINK NEXT TO 3 VAT SINK.
